quote's price, until the hold expires. Send an Idempotency-Key, the same on every retry: a
retry gets the first answer back.

- 409 QUOTE_EXPIRED or QUOTE_USED: ask for a new quote.
- 409 HOLD_LIMIT_REACHED, and 409 BED_UNAVAILABLE when no bed is free for the stay.
- 404 for a quote that isn't the student's own.

PriceCalendar.title: PriceCalendar
PriceCalendar.description:
What each room costs a month for a move-in each week, as quotes say (ARCHITECTURE §8.5):
the only data the PG page's price changes and urgency may come from.

PricingMarket.title: PricingMarket
PricingMarket.description:
What a PG's rents sit beside: each room's band and the locality's market, and the caps
in force.

PricingPreview.title: PricingPreview
PricingPreview.description:
What a quote made today would say were this rule set in force (ARCHITECTURE §8.6): the
student's breakdown, and the owner's fee, which is on the listed rent whatever the rules do
(rule 2). Nothing is stored.

PrivacyNoticeInfo.title: PrivacyNoticeInfo
PrivacyNoticeInfo.description:
The current privacy notice: its version, which consent must name, and its purposes. The
notice's text is the web app's.

PropertyUpdate.title: PropertyUpdate
PropertyUpdate.description: Only the fields sent change; ``licenceNumber: null`` clears it.

PublicListing.title: PublicListing
PublicListing.description:
A live listing as anyone sees it. Its location is the display point, 80 to 150 m from the
building; the address, the exact point and the owner's phone come only from .../contact.

PublicPolicies.title: PublicPolicies
PublicPolicies.description:
The terms in force, as the Pricing and token pages explain them. Students never pay a
platform fee (rule 1), so there is no student fee to state.

QuoteAdjustment.title: QuoteAdjustment
QuoteAdjustment.description: A rule that moved the rent: by ``bps``, or for an override, to ``rentPaise``.

QuoteClamp.title: QuoteClamp
QuoteClamp.description: A limit that held the price back: what was asked for, and what was allowed.

QuoteInfo.title: QuoteInfo
QuoteInfo.description:
A quote, as the student sees it: the rent for every month of the stay with how it was
worked out, the token and what's due at move-in, and the deposit and every mandatory charge
beside it (rule 7). It stands until ``expiresAt``.

Readiness.title: Readiness
Readiness.description: Readiness: whether this instance can serve traffic, with the state of each dependency.

RebookSearch.title: RebookSearch
RebookSearch.description:
A search for PGs like this one with a bed free for the student's move-in, once a booking
ended through no fault of theirs: its filters, as the search API takes them (step 5.7).

RentBandInput.title: RentBandInput
RentBandInput.description: A band for one locality and occupancy, in force from now; the one before ends.

RuleSetCalendar.title: RuleSetCalendar
RuleSetCalendar.description:
Each active room's rent for a move-in each week, were this rule set in force: the
editor's price chart.

SafetySummary.title: SafetySummary
SafetySummary.description: What the field agent found on their last visit that passed the building (ADR 0024).

SearchPlace.title: SearchPlace
SearchPlace.description: A campus with live PGs within ``radiusM``, or a locality with live PGs in it.

SeasonRuleParams.title: SeasonRuleParams
SeasonRuleParams.description:
Up or down by ``bps`` for move-ins from ``start`` to ``end`` (MM-DD, both included); may
wrap the year.

SessionInfo.title: SessionInfo
SessionInfo.description: One browser or device where the account is signed in.

SignInResult.title: SignInResult
SignInResult.description: Signed in, with the session cookie set. Use ``csrfToken`` (also a cookie) from now on.

StaffSignInResult.title: StaffSignInResult
StaffSignInResult.description: Signed in to staff tools: a staff session, ending 12 hours after sign-in.

StaffTotpSignIn.title: StaffTotpSignIn
StaffTotpSignIn.description: A code from the authenticator app, sent after signing in by phone.

StaffVisitPlace.title: StaffVisitPlace
StaffVisitPlace.description: The PG with its address and exact point: for staff, who take people there.

StudentBooking.title: StudentBooking
StudentBooking.description:
A booking as its student sees it: the quote's money, fixed for the stay (rule 5). The
exact address and the owner's phone show once the owner confirms (rule 11), from the PG's
contact.

StudentDispute.title: StudentDispute
StudentDispute.description: The student's report that the room isn't as shown, and where it stands.

StudentVisit.title: StudentVisit
StudentVisit.description: A visit as the student sees it. The address shows on the PG's page once it's booked.

TimelineEntry.title: TimelineEntry
TimelineEntry.description: One change to the booking, as its history has it.

UploadForm.title: UploadForm
UploadForm.description: Post the file here as multipart/form-data: every field, then the file as ``file``.

VisitCheckIn.title: VisitCheckIn
VisitCheckIn.description:
The visit log: when the agent checked in, where their phone said they were, how sure it
was, and how far that was from the building.

VisitChecklist.title: VisitChecklist
VisitChecklist.description: The agent's answers on site. Every field is required, so nothing is assumed.

VisitPlace.title: VisitPlace
VisitPlace.description: The property, as the agent needs it to get there: staff see the address and the pin.

WomenSafety.title: WomenSafety
WomenSafety.description: Features that make a PG safer for women, ticked where the agent saw them.

app__modules__visits__domain__visits__Ou.title: Outcome
app__modules__visits__domain__visits__Ou.description: How the visit went, as the agent records it.
